asserts: values, tql_tree, source_tree, bytecode

--- tql ---
def type_is(@n; @kind): @n.type | text = @kind;

. as @root
| type_is as @f
| @root / function_definition.declarator
| .parameters / parameter_declaration as @p
| @f(@p) as @partial
| select(@partial('int'))
| @p.declarator
| text
